craft_notes: Sthāyin: application-verse (method named: kriyā). Sanskrit: kuhanena prayogeṇa sadya eva...tattvaṃ prakāśate → L4 keeps trick+application then fruit. Rows: row 3 (manifests→shines). Close: shines (the double-light refrain: reality shines THROUGH bliss). Rejected: 'technique' — killed: application kept (prayoga as doing); 'deception' for kuhanā — killed: trick kept light (the text's own word).

lines: By trick, by application, at once, deer-eyed:
great bliss manifests — by which reality shines.
l4.sanskrit_cite: kuhanena prayogeṇa sadya eva mṛgekṣaṇe | samudeti mahānando yena tattvaṃ prakāśate

reads_against.argmap: How does great bliss manifest? → Applied technique manifests great bliss — and through it reality shines.
c1_essence: Application manifests great bliss — reality shines through.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta charged with vīra (wonder armed with intensity)
